_comment: Baseline for scripts/mypy_ratchet.py (#506). total is a ceiling, not an equality: the gate fails only when the count is ABOVE it. Packages in clean are pinned at exactly zero. Regenerate with 'python scripts/mypy_ratchet.py --update' and commit this file.

reference.note: Non-gating. setup.cfg sets ignore_missing_imports=True and redis-py types every command Awaitable[T] | T, so the count moves with the redis-py major. Recorded so a contributor on the uv.lock-resolved 7.1.1 can confirm the offset instead of investigating it.
